data.name: Kornelius
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Kornelius is a name of Cornelius, a centurion in the Roman army who was a God-fearing man. He was the first gentile to be converted to Christianity. The name Kornelius means 'horn of God' in Hebrew.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and loyalty to God.

in_english.name: Kornelius

data.cultural_impact: Kornelius is a Christian name that holds historical significance as the name of the first non-Jewish person to be converted to Christianity in the New Testament. This Name highlights the Christian community's openness and acceptance of people from all walks of life, including those outside the Jewish faith.

historical_references.reference: Cornelius Nepos, a Roman historian, wrote a biography of the Roman general and dictator Cornelius Scipio Africanus the Elder in the late 1st century BC.
